# Actually compute enclosure depth: how many layers of 8s surround each non-zero cell

outside = set()
for start in [(0,0), (0,cols-1), (rows-1,0), (rows-1,cols-1)]:

    while stack:
        r, c = stack.pop()
        if (r,c) in outside or r < 0 or r >= rows or c < 0 or c >= cols or demo_input[r][c] != 0:

        outside.add((r,c))

            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if 0<=nr<rows and 0<=nc<cols and demo_input[nr][nc]==0 and (nr,nc) not in outside:

visited_8 = set(eight_cells)
for r,c in eight_cells:

            dist_to_boundary[(nr,nc)] = dist_to_boundary[(r,c)] + 1
            queue.append((nr,nc))
